verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork marketing page claims AI agents "collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule." Its docs show connected integrations that continuously monitor AWS resources, GitHub configuration and access, and Google Workspace, and compliance controls are documented as holding evidence. However, scheduled evidence collection appears only as a one-line marketing claim, with no first-party docs on how artifacts are gathered, timestamped, or attached to controls. Missing for 10: technical docs describing scheduled collection cadence, timestamped machine-gathered artifacts replacing screenshots and CSVs, breadth of integrations feeding evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
